cancellation_summary: Runs rain or shine; tour may be canceled with notice for particularly unpleasant weather.
location_address: 400 N. Michigan Avenue Chicago, IL US 60611
description: Inside Chicago Walking Tours leads a festive, nostalgic stroll through downtown Chicago to showcase the city’s best holiday decorations and traditions. This limited-time pop-up tour visits iconic stops like the Christkindlmarkt and the old Marshall Field’s as well as lesser-known sites, guiding guests to impressive indoor and outdoor Christmas trees while sharing the history behind beloved holiday characters and customs. Perfect for families and friends, the walk blends culture, history and seasonal sights with opportunities for photos and warming stops inside select buildings.
what_is_included:
* Guided walking tour of downtown holiday decorations
* Visits to indoor and outdoor holiday displays and Christmas trees
* Stops at Christkindlmarkt and the old Marshall Field’s
* Brief indoor pop-ins to warm up and view indoor trees
